subject.title: Feature Request: Inline media display in chat (images, audio, video, web previews)

question: Should the remaining Control UI inline-media work allow remote Markdown images, rich web previews, and audio autoplay, and what remote-fetch/consent policy should those features use?
rationale: Current code intentionally blocks remote browser media fetches while the request asks for broad UX behavior that changes security and consent boundaries.

options.title: Keep the umbrella and split policy-backed slices
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, require maintainer approval for the remote-fetch and playback-consent policy, and track implementation through focused issues such as remote Markdown images and audio autoplay.

options.title: Close in favor of focused issues
options.body: Close the umbrella only after maintainers decide that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40945, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/86894, and any web-preview item fully cover the remaining work.

options.title: Approve direct remote previews
options.body: Accept the browser-fetch privacy tradeoff and implement renderer, CSP, docs, tests, and real browser proof together for direct remote media previews.

recommendation.title: Keep the umbrella and split policy-backed slices
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, require maintainer approval for the remote-fetch and playback-consent policy, and track implementation through focused issues such as remote Markdown images and audio autoplay.
